Package io.jans.lock.trace.crypto.bc.testkit

Class TraceTestKeys

java.lang.Object
io.jans.lock.trace.crypto.bc.testkit.TraceTestKeys
public final class TraceTestKeys extends Object
Test-only Ed25519 helpers shared by the whole TRACE test suite: provider installation, key generation, deterministic keys from RFC 8032 seeds, signing, and RFC 8037 JWK export of public keys (consolidated test kit).
